title: Pure Lair of Darkness
summary: Lair of Darkness Tribute-control build with the Lady of Lament engine, Darkest Diabolos, Lord of the Lair, Virus Normal Traps, and Super Polymerization. The Field Spell Lair of Darkness turns every face-up monster on the field into DARK Attribute and lets you Tribute an opponent's DARK monster once per turn to pay the Tribute cost of your effects.

summary.title: Starters
points: Ahrima, the Wicked Warden discards itself to search Lair of Darkness from the Deck, or Tributes a DARK monster on the field (including an opponent's monster under Lair) to draw a card or search a 2000+ DEF DARK monster such as Darkest Diabolos.
Lilith, Lady of Lament Tributes a DARK monster as a Quick Effect to reveal three Normal Traps from your Deck and Set the opponent's pick to your field.

Tour Guide From the Underworld Special Summons Lilith, Malice, or Alice, Lady of Lament from the Deck to Link Summon Muckraker From the Underworld, which then revives Lilith with her full 2000 original ATK and Quick Effect live.
Alice, Lady of Lament banishes a Trap from the GY to Special Summon itself and searches any Fiend whose ATK + DEF equals 2000 (Lilith, Malice, or Tour Guide) when Tributed or destroyed.

summary.title: Opening: Ahrima + Lilith or Tour Guide
steps: Discard Ahrima, the Wicked Warden (or activate Terraforming) to search and activate Lair of Darkness.
Normal Summon Lilith, Lady of Lament (or summon Tour Guide into Alice, Link into Muckraker From the Underworld, and discard to revive Lilith with 2000 ATK).

Pass turn with Lair of Darkness and Lilith active; when the opponent summons a monster, Lair turns it DARK so Lilith can Tribute their monster as cost to Set Eradicator Epidemic Virus, Deck Devastation Virus, or Ballista Squad from your Deck.

summary.title: Lair of Darkness & Darkest Diabolos
summary.text: Because Lair of Darkness replaces your Tribute cost once per turn with an opposing DARK monster, every Tribute effect—Lilith, Ahrima, Malice, Ballista Squad, and the Virus Traps—removes an opposing boss monster as cost before the opponent can respond. Whenever a DARK monster you control is Tributed, Darkest Diabolos, Lord of the Lair Special Summons itself from the hand or GY, cannot be Tributed or targeted by the opponent's card effects, and Tributes a DARK monster to place a card from the opponent's hand on the top or bottom of their Deck. In the End Phase, Lair of Darkness spawns Torment Tokens for every monster Tributed that turn.

summary.title: Viruses, Super Polymerization & Control
points: Eradicator Epidemic Virus (2500+ ATK DARK Tribute), Deck Devastation Virus (2000+ ATK DARK Tribute), and Full Force Virus (2000+ DEF DARK Tribute) Tribute either Darkest Diabolos or an opposing monster via Lair of Darkness to rip Spells, Traps, or low-stat monsters out of the opponent's field, hand, and next three draws.
Ballista Squad Tributes an opponent's monster under Lair of Darkness to destroy a second card they control, trading one Normal Trap for two opposing cards.

Super Polymerization uses Lair of Darkness's Attribute change to fuse any two non-Token monsters the opponent controls into Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, or a Fusion Monster plus another opposing monster into Predaplant Dragostapelia.

summary.title: Trap Recursion
points: Malice, Lady of Lament Tributes two monsters (including one opposing monster under Lair) as a Quick Effect to Set a banished or GY Normal Trap directly to your field.
Loris, Lady of Lament recycles three or six banished/GY Normal Traps into the Deck to draw cards and Sets a GY Normal Trap whenever another monster is Tributed.

allow.Tour Guide From the Underworld: Normal Summon starter that summons Lilith, Malice, or Alice, Lady of Lament directly from the Deck.
allow.Eradicator Epidemic Virus: Normal Trap (searchable by Lilith!) that Tributes a 2500+ ATK DARK monster (Darkest Diabolos or an opponent's monster via Lair!) to destroy all Spells or all Traps in the opponent's hand, field, and next 3 draws.
allow.Deck Devastation Virus: Normal Trap (searchable by Lilith!) that Tributes a 2000+ ATK DARK monster (Lilith, Ahrima, or an opponent's monster via Lair!) to destroy all 1500 or less ATK monsters in the opponent's hand, field, and next 3 draws.
allow.Full Force Virus: Normal Trap (searchable by Lilith!) that Tributes a 2000+ DEF DARK monster (Darkest Diabolos or an opponent's monster via Lair!) to destroy all 1500 or less DEF monsters.
allow.Ballista Squad: Normal Trap (searchable by Lilith!) that Tributes 1 monster (an opponent's monster via Lair of Darkness!) to target and destroy 1 other card your opponent controls—removing 2 opposing cards with 1 Trap while triggering Darkest Diabolos!
allow.Super Polymerization: Because Lair of Darkness turns every face-up monster on the opponent's field into DARK Attribute, Super Polymerization can fuse any 2 of your opponent's monsters into Starving Venom Fusion Dragon or Predaplant Dragostapelia!
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Lair of Darkness.
allow.Starving Venom Fusion Dragon: Level 8 DARK Dragon Fusion (2 DARK monsters on the field, except Tokens) summoned using 2 of your opponent's monsters via Super Polymerization while Lair of Darkness is active!
allow.Predaplant Dragostapelia: Level 8 DARK Fusion (1 Fusion Monster + 1 DARK monster) summoned via Super Polymerization under Lair of Darkness that negates opposing monster effects.
allow.Muckraker From the Underworld: Link-2 DARK Fiend that tributes a Fiend and revives Lilith, Lady of Lament from the GY.

main: Lilith, Lady of Lament

Core Level 3 DARK Fiend (2000 ATK if Normal Summoned): Quick Effect to Tribute 1 DARK monster (an opponent's monster while Lair of Darkness is active!) to reveal 3 Normal Traps from your Deck and Set 1 of them to your field.
Ahrima, the Wicked Warden

Core Level 4 DARK Fiend: discards itself from hand to add 1 'Lair of Darkness' from your Deck to your hand; on the field, tributes 1 DARK monster to either draw 1 card or search a 2000+ DEF DARK monster (Darkest Diabolos!).
Darkest Diabolos, Lord of the Lair

Signature Level 8 DARK Dragon boss (3000 ATK / 2000 DEF): cannot be Tributed or targeted by opponent's card effects; Special Summons itself from hand or GY whenever a DARK monster you control is Tributed, and tributes 1 DARK monster to rip a card from the opponent's hand.
Malice, Lady of Lament
Level 3 DARK Fiend: Quick Effect to Tribute 2 monsters (including 1 opponent's monster under Lair of Darkness!) to Set 1 of your banished or GY Normal Traps directly to your field.
Alice, Lady of Lament
Level 3 DARK Fiend: banishes a Trap from GY to Special Summon itself from hand, and searches any Fiend whose ATK + DEF equals 2000 (Lilith, Malice, or Tour Guide!) when Tributed or destroyed.
Loris, Lady of Lament
Level 3 DARK Fiend: shuffles 3 or 6 of your banished/GY Normal Traps into the Deck to draw 1 or 2 cards, and sets a Trap from GY when another monster is Tributed.
Tour Guide From the Underworld
Summons Alice, Malice, or Lilith from the Deck to link into Muckraker (which then revives Lilith with her full 2000 ATK and Quick Effect live!).
Lair of Darkness

Signature Field Spell: turns all face-up monsters on the field into DARK Attribute; once per turn, if you would Tribute a monster you control, you can Tribute 1 DARK monster your opponent controls instead; generates Torment Tokens during the End Phase.
Super Polymerization
Fuses 2 of your opponent's monsters (both turned DARK by Lair of Darkness!) into Starving Venom Fusion Dragon.
Ballista Squad
Normal Trap searched by Lilith: Tributes 1 monster (an opponent's monster via Lair of Darkness!) to destroy 1 other card they control.
Eradicator Epidemic Virus
Normal Trap searched by Lilith: Tributes a 2500+ ATK DARK monster (Darkest Diabolos, Starving Venom, or an opponent's boss monster via Lair!) to wipe all Spells or all Traps.
Deck Devastation Virus
Normal Trap searched by Lilith: Tributes a 2000+ ATK DARK monster (Lilith or an opponent's monster via Lair!) to wipe all 1500 or less ATK monsters.
Full Force Virus
Normal Trap searched by Lilith: Tributes a 2000+ DEF DARK monster to wipe all 1500 or less DEF monsters.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Lair of Darkness.
extra: Level 8 DARK Dragon Fusion (2 DARK monsters on the field, except Tokens): summoned via Super Polymerization using ANY 2 of your opponent's non-Token monsters while Lair of Darkness is on the field!
Level 8 DARK Fusion summoned via Super Polymerization using an opponent's Fusion Monster + any other monster they control under Lair of Darkness.
Link-2 DARK Fiend that discards a card to revive Lilith, Lady of Lament from the GY (where she has 2000 ATK and her Tribute Quick Effect fully live!).
